metaTitle: Custom 3/4 Inch Wide Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 3/4 inch wide lanyards and badges for your team. Perfect for ID badges, keys, or event credentials. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Choosing a 3/4 inch wide lanyard strikes a balance between durability and comfort, making it a popular choice for daily badge or key carry. This width is narrow enough to feel lightweight around the neck yet wide enough to support a sturdy attachment for ID cards or keys. Options like the 3/4" Woven Lanyard or the 3/4" Recycled Lanyard offer full-color imprinting for branding, while the 3/4" Nylon Web Lanyard provides a more rugged feel. Whether for employee IDs, conference badges, or event credentials, custom 3/4 inch wide lanyards and badges deliver a professional look that fits comfortably all day.
heroAltText: Custom 3/4 inch wide lanyards and badges with full-color imprinting, ideal for ID cards and event credentials.
